name: Penny Wong I move amendment (15) on sheet 7778: (15) Schedule 1, item 4, page 44 (lines 15 to 20), omit paragraph 52(2)(b), substitute: (b) the value of the interest in the land is more than: (i) $50 million; or (ii) if a higher value is prescribed for the purposes of this paragraph—that higher value. Sean Edwards The question is that amendment (15) on sheet 7778 be agreed to.
